text:
mira: heads up — ap-southeast1 canary is seeing a spike in local NVMe badblock marks, GPU attaches are getting held.
owen: saw the alert, link?
infra-bot: [alert] nvme_badblocks_detected on cohort 'hotstripe-12' in ap-southeast1 — impact: 18% attach failures, 37% retry rate
mira: repro steps from node logs:
```
[ 1234.567890] nvme0n1: 5 IO errors, marking block 0x3af2
[ 1234.568012] janitor: tempfile-sweep slowing, fsync backlog 1200ms
[ 1234.569001] gpu-provisioner: attach-failed: underlying storage flagged read-only
```
owen: interesting that janitor backlog coincides. could be cleaner thrash exposing old firmware corner-case.
kai: any SMART data? can we bulk-check a sample? I'll run `smartctl -a /dev/nvme0n1` on a few nodes.
sasha: cost note — if we fallback to eu-west we pay cross-region bandwidth and preemptible churn. how long do we expect this to take to mitigate?
mira: short-term plan: 1) pause canary (done) 2) drain hotstripe-12 cohort from new launches 3) disable aggressive janitor sweeps on affected pool 4) run scrub + re-evaluate kernel nvme timeout settings
owen: agree. also add a temporary provisioner policy: prefer pools without high-temp counters for spot GPUs. deploy-bot can we update rollout policy to skip ap-southeast1?
deploy-bot: rollout policy updated: excluded regions=["ap-southeast1"] for canary-service v0.42.3
kai: smart output from node gnode-ax3:
```
smartctl: nvme0n1 - SMART/Health Information
critical_warning: 0
temperature: 72 C
data_units_written: 1,024,312
media_errors: 12
```
kai: temp is high but not catastrophic. media_errors > expected though — looks like read-error amplitude.
sasha: we need to weigh: throttle janitor reduces cleanup IO but increases ephemeral disk occupancy/costs and could delay reclaiming. ops cost vs. provisioning lead time.
mira: proposal: throttle janitor to 30% aggressiveness for 2 hours, kick a targeted scrub on cohort nodes, then re-enable canary if attach failures < 3%.
owen: +1. also add a telemetry spike alert to trigger auto-rollback if attach-failures > 10% for 5min.
infra-bot: action created: TICKET-7543 "ap-southeast1 nvme badblock cohort mitigation" assigned to mira, owen; severity=P2; due=+6h
sasha: will coordinate finance if rollback extends beyond day — provisional cross-region cost estimate attached in ticket
mira: I'll run the scrub now and post progress. tagging eng-oncall to monitor.
infra-bot: jira TICKET-7543 created; comment updated with scrub-start time.
mira: scrub kicked on 6 nodes. status: 6/6 started. attaching logs shortly.
owen: thanks. keep posts short here, ping if attach rate climbs.
mira: (after 25m) scrub complete on 6 nodes — media_errors reduced to single digits, attach failures dropped to 2.4% across canary group.
kai: looks like janitor throttling helped. recommend a gradual re-enable with 10% bump per 30m.
sasha: noted. finance comfortable for temporary rollback window if needed.
mira: re-enable plan scheduled. will re-open canary in 45m if stable. :thumbsup:
